description: Search worldwide stratigraphic columns (a summary of the rock units at one location) by point location (lat/lng), stratigraphic name, chronostratigraphic time interval, lithology, or geologic age (Ma). Returns column IDs, names, coordinates, area, and thickness — use the returned col_id with macrostrat.units_search or macrostrat.fossils_search. Data: macrostrat.org/api/v2, no auth required, CC BY 4.0.

adjacents.description: If lat+lng given, also return columns touching the same polygon (default false)

age.description: Numerical age in millions of years before present (Ma)

age_bottom.description: Older bound of an age range in Ma — must be used with age_top

age_top.description: Younger bound of an age range in Ma — must be used with age_bottom

interval_name.description: Chronostratigraphic time interval name, e.g. "Permian" or "Cretaceous"

lat.description: Decimal degree latitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lng

lith.description: Lithology name to filter by, e.g. "sandstone" or "shale"

lng.description: Decimal degree longitude (WGS84) — must be supplied together with lat

strat_name.description: Fuzzy stratigraphic name to match, e.g. "mancos" or "jordan"

name: macrostrat.geology.columns_search

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Macrostrat Stratigraphic Column Search
